title: DBS removes points transfers to Qantas Frequent Flyer
caption:
💼 BREAKING: DBS removes points transfers to Qantas Frequent Flyer

DBS credit cards no longer offer points transfers to Qantas Frequent Flyer, leaving KrisFlyer and Asia Miles as the only realistic options.
